Scheduled for April 15-22, 2026, the inaugural Fleet Week Houston will bring multiple U.S. Navy vessels and more than 1,000 Sailors, Marines and Coast Guardsmen to the city for a series of events and experiences.Fleet Week Houston is being celebrated during America 250, the official nationwide celebration of the United States’ 250th anniversary. The City of Houston is hosting Fleet Week in collaboration with partners including the Port of Houston, Houston First Corporation and others. This event marks the first time a Texas city has hosted Navy Fleet Week. Frequently Asked Questions How do I get tickets to Fleet Week Houston? This event is free to the public to attend. See menu for information about events and registering for tours. do I need any special authorization to bring a group? No prior authorization is required to bring groups. We encourage groups to attend on a weekday to avoid the crowds and long lines. What volunteer opportunities are available? We invite all Houstonians and the community in the greater Houston area 16 years old+ to apply. Are reservations needed to tour an active duty ship? No reservations are required, but visitors are required to join a queue to be assigned a time. See menu for details. To top
